compliance.summary: The article’s general finance content is not the main issue, but its GoGloby section sells AI adoption, workflow implementation, and legacy tools rather than the company’s recruiting and staffing services. It also includes unsupported claims about timelines, security, performance targets, and the founder’s credentials.

llm_problems.title: Applied AI implementation positioning
llm_problems.rule: decisions.md: Company description; Fact Sheet: Identity and Services
llm_problems.issue: The page positions GoGloby as an Applied AI engineering and finance-workflow implementation provider, rather than a staffing and recruiting agency specializing in hiring Data & AI Engineers.
llm_problems.fix: Reposition the GoGloby section around the approved company description and its recruiting and staffing services.

llm_problems.source_value: Staffing and recruiting agency specializing in hiring Data & AI Engineers
